checks.observation: Position.isValid requires each x/y/z component to be finite and in inclusive -100...100. LightingScene.validated applies it to subject and camera, and StudioLight.isValid applies it to light positions.

StudioLight.isValid requires a nonblank name of at most 80 Swift characters; finite candela in inclusive 0...100000; finite kelvin in inclusive 1000...20000; and validation of optional optics. Nil optics remains valid by design.
LightingScene.validated delegates a present cameraLens to CameraLens.isValid, which requires finite focalLengthMillimeters in inclusive 14...200. Nil uses the documented default.
LightOptics.isValid checks any aim target through Position.isValid, finite width and height in inclusive 0.05...4, and finite effective roll in inclusive -180...180. Nil roll resolves to zero.
The unconditional lights.count <= 12 guard applies before per-light checks. An empty rig is accepted, consistent with docs/DESIGN.md explicitly describing empty-rig selection behavior.
Set(lights.map(\.id)).count == lights.count rejects repeated UUID values with duplicateLight after per-light validation.

SceneTests.testRejectDuplicateIDs checks the precise duplicateLight error. testLightCountBoundaryAcrossSchemas constructs twelve unique valid lights and checks acceptance, then checks rejection of thirteen with invalidScene for each supported schema. testRejectInvalidLight exercises invalid kelvin through SceneCodec.encode. No tests were executed.
checks.result: Relevant assertions present in reviewed test source

checks.observation: SceneTests.swift itself has no direct matrix for NaN, +/-infinity or boundary-adjacent subject/camera coordinates, candela, kelvin, camera-lens values or optics values. Dedicated camera/optics/other validation test files were not reviewed, so this is not a claim of a repository-wide missing regression or a product defect.
